.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/creat.instruction: Run {{script}} "<command name>" ["<optional content>"], where `<command name>` is the space-separated command words (e.g. "compile artifact") and the optional second argument is the body content to place inside the exported function.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/list/.instruction: Run the script as `{{script}} [search term]`, omitting the argument to list every command.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/updat.instruction: Run {{script}} <command-path> <change-request>, where `<command-path>` is the space-separated command name (e.g. `"compile artifact"`) and `<change-request>` is ignored by this step but should still be passed as the second argument.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/delet.instruction: Run {{script}} <word1> [word2 ... wordN] where the words together are the command's name (e.g. `{{script}} compile artifact`), with the last word naming the file and any preceding words naming its parent folders.
Run {{script}} <command path words...> (e.g. `{{script}} compile artifact`) to print every reference to that command as `[file path]:[line number]`.

.gstudio/artifacts/command/scripts/evalu.instruction: Run {{script}} with the command path as space-separated words (e.g. `{{script}} compile artifact`) to evaluate the corresponding src/commands/.../*.command.ts file.

create.text: Scaffolds a new command file at src/commands/{path}.command.ts with an empty or given body, exiting 1 if the file already exists.

list.text: Lists all commands in src/commands matching an optional search term, printing each as "command path: file path".

update.text: Applies a natural-language change request to an existing command file at src/commands, given the command path and a description of the change, failing if the command file does not exist

delete.text: Deletes a command artifact's file at src/commands and removes all dangling references to it found elsewhere in the codebase, given the command path.

evaluate.text: Checks that a command file has exactly one top-level default-exported async function reading only args and context.flags and delegating all logic to src/classes, given the command path.
